note: Set A binds section designations to the correct elevations/details more consistently (HSS4X4X1/4 in C3, HSS4X6X1/4 and L3x3x1/4" in C1, W8X10 in the North/Bedroom elevation, W10X12 in A1) and keeps the key datums (SOLAR ENVELOPE 18'-0", T.O. STEEL 11'-4", 32'-0", 27'-8", 7'-6", 12'-0", 10'-0") with supporting quotes. Set B adds the useful FIRST FLR 2'-4" datum but introduces clear errors: C4 is a detail/section callout not a column identifier, the 27'-8" dimension is restated as "27 ft", and 9'-0" is misbound as grade-to-T.O.-steel (that span is 11'-4"; 9'-0" is first floor to T.O. steel), plus several vague "Structural Member" claims. Set A's weaknesses are invented qualifiers ("right side upper", "rightmost", "Bracing member", "Lower beam", "between C4 and Grid 6", "between grid D and C1") and three duplicated claims, but its value-to-component binding is still more faithful overall.
